mapper.select: SELECT id FROM webhook_delivery WHERE (status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT') AND next_attempt_at<=#{nextAttemptAt}) OR (status='IN_FLIGHT' AND lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY updated_at,id LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE webhook_attempt SET finished_at=#{finishedAt},result='OUTCOME_UNKNOWN',error_code='OUTCOME_UNKNOWN' WHERE delivery_id=#{id} AND attempt_no=#{attempts} AND finished_at IS NULL

UPDATE webhook_attempt SET finished_at=#{finishedAt},result=#{success},http_status=#{httpStatus},error_code=#{errorCode} WHERE delivery_id=#{id} AND attempt_no=#{attempts} AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND finished_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM webhook_delivery WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM webhook_attempt WHERE delivery_id=#{id} ORDER BY attempt_no DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM webhook_retry_request WHERE delivery_id=#{id} ORDER BY requested_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE webhook_delivery SET status=#{status},version=#{version},attempts=#{attempts},cycle_attempts=#{cycleAttempts},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},lease_token=#{leaseToken},http_status=#{httpStatus},error_code=#{errorCode},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT id,target_id,event_id,event_type,application_id,aggregate_version,occurred_at,updated_at,status,version,attempts,cycle_attempts,next_attempt_at,lease_until,http_status,error_code FROM webhook_delivery WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND target_id=#{argument2} AND status=#{argument3} AND application_id=#{argument4} AND (occurred_at<#{argument5} OR (occurred_at=#{argument6} AND id<#{argument7})) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{argument8}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='IN_FLIGHT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS in_flight, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='RETRY_WAIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS retry_wait, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='DELIVERED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS delivered, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS failed FROM webhook_delivery WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND target_id=#{argument2} AND application_id=#{argument3}
